findings: Tests are real with concrete assertions, not stubs: they create test projects, verify file contents and structure, and validate behavior

Tests are mapped 1:1 to spec scenarios S1-S5: S1 tests scaffolding with anvil init/new-project/onboard and non-overwrite behavior, S2 verifies scaffold structure and absence of factory style, S3 validates packet injection to interface stations, S4 confirms reviewer-design in catalog and pipelines, S5 checks warnings and findings for missing design system

Each test verifies the exact requirements from its corresponding spec scenario, including edge cases like edited files not being overwritten (S1) and non-interface stations not receiving design sections (S3)
Test coverage is complete: all five spec scenarios have corresponding tests that validate both positive and negative cases
